name: Butterfly Wing Umbrella Workshop
description: A cozy artisan workshop where beautiful umbrellas are crafted from iridescent butterfly wings, silk threads, and delicate wooden frames, with natural light streaming through windows.
prompt: A cozy wooden workshop interior with natural sunlight streaming through large windows. Various iridescent butterfly wings in shades of blue, orange, and purple are arranged by color on wooden tables. Half-finished umbrellas with intricate wing patterns hang from the ceiling. Silk threads, wooden frames, and crafting tools scattered around. Warm, inviting atmosphere, detailed textures, 8k
caption: Where fashion meets the flutter of wings! 🦋☂️ Step into this artisan's dream workshop, where every umbrella is a captured sunset made from butterfly wings. If you could have wings instead of an umbrella, what color would they be? Drop a 🦋 if you'd wear these!
